instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/risky_setup.FCStd in FreeCAD 0.21.2 Path/CAM. Preserve its centered 120 x 80 x 18 mm WorkpiecePlate, all sixteen editable D5 x 10 mm blind candidate-hole records, and all three solid fixture objects. The G54 origin is the plate XY center at bottom Z=0, with the top at Z=18. Candidate centers are the 4 x 4 grid X={-45,-15,15,45} mm and Y={-27,-9,9,27} mm, numbered H01-H16 by rows from Y=-27 to Y=27 and left to right. Use a conservative D12 mm tool/holder envelope for both tools and require at least 3.000 mm net XY clearance from every fixture solid projection: net clearance is the minimum distance from the hole axis to a fixture XY rectangle minus the 6 mm envelope radius. Create an editable planning object whose visible name is exactly Collision Filter and link it to all candidates and fixtures. This calculation makes H04, H13, and H16 collision risks; skip them completely and machine exactly the other thirteen safe holes. Create exactly one Path/CAM Job with exactly two native Drilling operations: T1 is a D3 mm 90-degree spot drill that spots every safe hole to absolute Z=17.000 mm, and T2 is a D5 mm 118-degree twist drill that drills every safe hole to the existing blind-hole floor Z=8.000 mm. Use the standard FreeCAD drill ToolBit shape, forward/clockwise M3 at S7000 rpm, and horizontal and vertical feeds of F500 mm/min for both tools. Use G54, safe/retract heights above the Z=18 top, and the stock LinuxCNC postprocessor. G81, G82, or G83 and G98 or G99 are acceptable when their parameters preserve these locations, depths, and safe retraction. Save the editable document and matching native program exactly as /home/user/Desktop/task-15.FCStd and /home/user/Desktop/task-15.nc. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH).
